info.title: Liasio API
info.description: Self-hosted file sharing. API keys are sent only as Authorization: Bearer. Browser cookies are never API credentials. A download event means authorization, not confirmed receipt.

get.description: Required scope: read. Only currently accessible resources are returned.

409.description: Idempotency mismatch or changed upload offset

post.description: Required scope: files:write. Only currently accessible resources are returned.
